text:
Lina Park: quick check  noticed sparklines in dashboard cards are almost invisible in dark theme on lower-brightness displays. Can we discuss fixes?
Marco Diaz: Screenshot? is it contrast or the line width?
Lina Park: Attached in figma. 1px lines + grid makes them read as part of the background. The blue and magenta both lose identity.
Ivy (a11y): For tiny visuals treat them as low-visibility elements; WCAG suggests ~3:1 for UI graphics used to convey info. tiny strokes need either higher luminance delta or an outline/halo.
Marco Diaz: Options: (A) bump lightness for strokes <=1.5px, (B) add a subtle halo layer, (C) use patterned strokes for secondary series. I'm leaning to halo + small lightness bump.
Lina Park: Agree. Also the syntax block in the console feels "warm" because keyword blue is near the chart cyan. Suggest cooler keyword tone + muted string color.
Marco Diaz: Proposed tokens: ```
--bg-900: #061018
--panel-800: #0c1519
--chart-accent-1: #4ecad0
--chart-accent-1-muted: #6adbd7
--chart-accent-2: #ff9fa8
--chart-halo: rgba(4,8,12,0.22)
--code-bg: #0b1320
--code-fg: #d8eef6
--code-keyword: #8fc6ff
--code-string: #ffd8a6
```
Lina Park: I like `--chart-halo` as a token. For rendering, prefer double-path trick instead of SVG filter for perf.
Ivy (a11y): Also don't rely on alpha-only for semantics; browsers render alpha differently. For colorblind users add shape markers on hover/legend: dot, square, dash.
Marco Diaz: UX copy nit: theme toggle currently "Dark (recommended)". Can we change to "Dark  higher contrast" and add a tooltip linking to the accessibility rationale?
Lina Park: +1. I'll add the tooltip copy: "Provides higher contrast for dense dashboards and visualizations."
DevBot: Reminder: design-token change detected. Run visual-regression and accessibility-sim.
Marco Diaz: I'll run daltonize + contrast audit and post before/after screenshots here by 1805679500.
Ivy (a11y): I'll validate halo approach on low-brightness panels and retina scales. Also request a small-sparkline stress test with many series.
Lina Park: Plan: Marco pushes token PR + screenshots, I update Figma with halo example and tooltip mock, Ivy runs accessibility checks. If green, roll to canary. Thanks :thumbsup:
